notes: Partition verified: s001–s016 and t001–t020 each appear once.

Two article treatments in one verse, both read off the ASV: the first chain renders its rectum anarthrously so the single 'the' is fronted onto the rectum's article, while 'the laughter of the fool' is arthrous and each 'the' stands before its own word (rule 29).

The copula 'is' is placed on kēn as an adverbial anchor under rule 20; the competing reading, giving it to the fronted kə-phrase as the clause's prepositional predicate under rule 49, is named in that unit's note.
The waw of wəgam is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no connective for it (rule 14); gam keeps 'also' and zeh 'this'.
